name: Four in a Row
shortDescription: Drop pieces into the columns. The first to line up 4 wins.
rules:
The upright frame has 7 columns and 6 rows. Players take turns choosing a column to drop a piece into; it falls to the lowest empty cell. Yellow moves first.

The first to get **4 in a row** horizontally, vertically or diagonally wins.

If the frame fills up with no winner, the game is a draw.
